title: After-Sales SaaS Ruiyun Service Cloud Raises Multi-$10M A and A+
summary: On Sep 22, 2022, after-sales / field-service SaaS Ruiyun Service Cloud (瑞云服务云) (Suzhou Ruiyun Zhifu; founded Feb 2021) closed multi-$10M A (Chuxin lead, Lanhui follow) + A+ (Matrix Partners China exclusive) for ecosystem, R&D, GTM, and working capital. Built on 10+ years / 200+
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · October 11, 2022

On Sep 22, 2022, after-sales / field-service SaaS Ruiyun Service Cloud (瑞云服务云) (Suzhou Ruiyun Zhifu; founded Feb 2021) closed multi-$10M A (Chuxin lead, Lanhui follow) + A+ (Matrix Partners China exclusive) for ecosystem, R&D, GTM, and working capital. Built on 10+ years / 200+ enterprise practice: online CS, field service, parts, settlement, equipment lifecycle, service marketing + AI/IoT/AR predictive service. CEO Wang Zhongtian estimates <5% of mid/large China firms have full after-sales systems. 1,000+ logos: Bosch Siemens, Philips, FANUC, Keep, Micoe, BOMAG, Sakura, Puaí Medical… Connect / efficiency / value-add thesis (WeChat service number private pool; mobile work orders; warranty/trade-in upsell).

— END —
